item.title: London taxis granted long-sought left turn access into Euston Station rank and drop-off area
item.description: Licensed taxis are set to regain direct access to the ranks at London Euston Station following a Transport for London (TfL) proposal to allow a left turn from the A501 Euston Road into Churchway. item.title: Government’s £4,000 Plug-in Taxi Grant set to end in April, raising cost pressures for electric taxi buyers
item.description: The UK’s Plug-in Taxi Grant (PiTG) is expected to come to an end within the next few months, bringing down the curtain on a scheme that has underpinned much of the transition to purpose-built ultra-low emission taxis since 2019. item.title: Black taxi destroyed in suspected arson in Glasgow

item.title: Bolt submits data showing out-of-area private hire drivers receive LESS complaints compared to drivers working their licensed area
item.description: Ride-hailing operator Bolt has submitted further written evidence to the Transport Select Committee, setting out data and policy arguments in support of cross-border private hire work and warning against tighter geographic restrictions in any future reform of taxi and private hire licensing.The submission follows Bolt’s oral evidence session during the Committee’s inquiry into taxi and private hire licensing standards.
